correctness.rationale: Complete topological proof: unique cut point -> petal permutation; infinite cycles wander; finite cycles reduce to fixed-point interval dynamics of circle returns and orientation-reversing squares; the complete petal criterion follows. Finite invariant cores and a commuting retraction prove two-sided equicontinuity. Direct wandering separated-set bounds plus the cited universal regular-curve upper bound give h_pol=1; equicontinuity gives h_pol=0. Both examples explicit.

value.rationale: The Hawaiian earring is the canonical compact non-local-dendrite regular curve, directly motivated by the open classification question in arXiv:2602.19256v1. The complete family-wide entropy spectrum and exact dynamical criterion classify ALL its homeomorphisms, with a stronger nonwandering=periodic theorem and a finite-petal-cycle structural test. This addresses a natural, nontrivial subcase without claiming to solve the general question.
